sources: Google Maps place 'River Country RV Prark', 2221 Kings Creek Rd, Piney Creek (via audit/private_gap_browser/gm.py)
summary: Nothing confirmable: the operator has no web page beyond Facebook (2.4K followers, 92% recommend over 22 reviews, a September post 'We still have some availability for your RV or tent', phone (336) 359-8900 matches). Facebook states no rate, season, hookups or site count; the note's figures and the derived groups rest on aggregator listings and were left. No booking engine found.
flags: Presence (AWH 2026-10-14 rule): Facebook-only. The email domain on the Facebook page, rivercountrycampgroundnc.com, serves an empty directory index; Google Maps lists it as 'River Country RV Prark' with 4 reviews and no phone or website; no booking engine found (RoverPass has only an unclaimed listing under the older name 'River Camp USA', updated 2024-11-15).

No operator rate dated 2024+: neither Facebook nor any operator page posts a price (aggregators: RoverPass unclaimed $40/night, Campendium $30). The entry has no fees, so the US$50 gate can't be checked and long-stay test 2 (posted nightly price or booking engine) fails.
rivercountrycampground.com (a name match, not linked from the entry) is now a camping-tips content site unrelated to this park; don't use it.
